narrationTexts: Confirmed: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in `[src/pricing.js:39](src/pricing.js:39)` taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, despite its own comment saying otherwise.

Fixed by computing tax on `discounted` instead of raw `cents`. Nothing else was broken.
